appearance_facts.fact: A pale yellow wedge occupies the top-left quadrant, extending from the 12 o'clock position to approximately the 10 o'clock position.
A dark red wedge is situated on the left side, spanning from approximately the 10 o'clock position to the 7 o'clock position.
An orange-red wedge occupies the bottom portion of the circle, extending from the 7 o'clock position to the 4 o'clock position.
A light orange wedge fills the right side of the circle, spanning from the 4 o'clock position back to the 12 o'clock position.
The pale yellow wedge (upper-left) and the light orange wedge (right) appear to be the largest areas, while the dark red wedge (left) is intermediate in size.
